name: Compact
author: Freek van Gool
description: A compact layout for small screens: rotary knobs with the label underneath, the knobs grouped per section in one frame (filters next to the amplifier, oscillators next to the master) and a smaller scope, at roughly half the width and half the height of the standard card.

appearances.name: Compact
appearances.description: Rotary knobs in grouped frames, about half the standard width.
